title: Launch
caption: Artemis II lifts off from Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center, 6:35 p.m. EDT on 1 April.

title: Lunar flyby
caption: Earthset over the Moon's far side, photographed by the crew during the flyby.

title: The crew
caption: Christina Koch, Jeremy Hansen, Reid Wiseman and Victor Glover (clockwise from left) inside Orion on the way home, the day after the flyby.

title: Bound for home
caption: Orion and a crescent Earth, seen by a camera on one of Orion's solar array wings on the way home.

title: Splashdown
caption: Orion descends under its three main parachutes toward the Pacific Ocean near San Diego.
